S: Princess Vespa's hair bun cheese gougères
the royal hairdo, in cheese puff form

Light, crisp choux puffs baked with gruyère and a pinch of mustard, piped into coiled buns and served warm from the oven. Heat the oven to 200C. Bring 125ml water, 125ml milk, 100g butter and a pinch of salt to the boil, then beat in 150g plain flour until it forms a ball. Cool 5 minutes, then beat in 4 eggs one at a time with 1 tsp Dijon mustard. Stir in 120g grated gruyère. Pipe 30 small coils onto lined trays and sprinkle with more cheese. Bake 22 minutes until puffed and golden.
Pretzel rods dipped in dark chocolate with a striped candy melt plaid
Pretzel rods dipped in melted chocolate and striped with coloured candy melts in a plaid pattern.
Cereal, pretzel and peanut mix baked in honey butter, with mini marshmallows
Cereal squares, pretzels, peanuts and mini marshmallows tossed in butter and honey, baked at 140C for 20 minutes.
M: Deep pan pizza loaded with mozzarella, provolone, cheddar and pepperoni
Deep pan pizza loaded with four cheeses (mozzarella, provolone, parmesan, cheddar), pepperoni and sauce, baked at 220C for 20 minutes until molten.
Moon diner corned beef hash and eggs
the roadside diner on the moon, with an unexpected guest

Diced potatoes fried crisp with onion and shredded corned beef, two runny fried eggs on top, chives, hot sauce and buttered toast. Boil 800g diced potatoes for 6 minutes and drain well. Fry in 3 tbsp oil and 30g butter for 12 minutes until golden. Add 1 diced onion and cook 5 minutes, then fold in 400g shredded cooked corned beef and press flat for 5 minutes to crisp the bottom. Fry 8 eggs. Serve the hash topped with two eggs each, chives, hot sauce and buttered toast.
W: Honey vanilla Greek yogurt layered with granola and mixed berries
Greek yoghurt whipped with honey and vanilla, layered with crunchy granola and fresh berries in tall glasses.
K: Perri-Air sparkling lime and mint cooler
Lime, mint and cucumber with sparkling water over ice, no alcohol

Fresh lime and mint muddled with sugar syrup and cucumber, topped with ice-cold sparkling water and served tall, as precious as a can of air. Muddle 12 mint leaves, 4 slices cucumber and 60ml sugar syrup in a jug. Add the juice of 3 limes and stir. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and divide the mix between them. Top each with 150ml cold sparkling water. Garnish with a mint sprig and a lime wheel.

s.note: Chocolate pretzel rods striped plaid with candy melts
s.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate and dip 20 pretzel rods two-thirds of the way. Set on baking paper. Melt 100g coloured candy melts, pipe stripes across in two directions for a plaid pattern and let them set.

s.note: Honey butter mix of cereal, pretzels, peanuts and marshmallows
s.how: Toss 150g cereal squares, 100g pretzels and 100g peanuts with 50g butter melted with 2 tbsp honey. Bake at 140C for 20 minutes, stirring once. Cool completely, then toss through 100g mini marshmallows.

m.note: Molten deep pan four-cheese pepperoni pizza
m.how: Press 600g pizza dough into an oiled deep tray and prove 30 minutes. Spread with a jar of pizza sauce and pile on 200g mozzarella, 100g provolone, 50g parmesan, 100g cheddar and 100g pepperoni. Bake at 220C for 20 minutes until molten.

w.note: Honey vanilla yoghurt layered with granola and berries
w.how: Whip 500g Greek yoghurt with 3 tbsp honey and a little vanilla. Layer in four tall glasses with 200g granola and 250g mixed berries, finishing with berries on top. Serve straight away so the granola stays crunchy.
